basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old mechanical engineer based in Toronto, Canada. I've recently developed an interest in collecting and building intricate brick models, especially themed around fantasy worlds like LOTR. Aside from this hobby, I enjoy exploring men's fashion trends and play the mobile game Random Dice in my free time. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8 PM to 11 PM EST. Currently single, I spend weekends visiting local hobby shops or catching up on fashion blogs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My interest in building models started as a kid with LEGO sets, but I've recently expanded into other brands. I primarily learn through online reviews and community recommendations. My engineering background gives me a keen eye for design and structural stability, which I apply to my hobby.
